author: Maniacal Art Management
title: Calling Dark Fantasy Artists for The Maniacal Archive
content: CALLING DARK FANTASY ARTISTS! Another week, another step closer to bringing The Maniacal Archive to life! And this week, I've officially opened our ARTIST APPLICATIONS! https://forms.gle/XNd1ZgUG4Tp973uG7 I've spent so much time developing Emberblossom, its characters, their stories, and the wonderfully chaotic world where Maniacal Art Management operates. But there's one tiny problem... I CAN'T DRAW ALL THESE DAMN CHARACTERS MYSELF! So I'm looking for talented artists who can help bring my creations to life! I'm particularly interested in artists who enjoy fantasy character design, demons, mythical creatures, expressive personalities, and beautiful, imaginative worlds. And here's the exciting part... This isn't just for the Kickstarter! I'm hoping to build long term relationships with artists for future character illustrations, monthly Archive Mailers, merchandise, and other MAM projects. These are paid opportunities, and I'm looking for artists whose styles, creativity, and professional goals align with what we're building. ARTIST APPLICATIONS ARE NOW OPEN! Interested in helping bring Emberblossom to life? You can find the application on our Kickstarter preview page! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maniacalartmgmt/1827576044 Contact via Google Form and Kickstarter.

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: SALTO Participation & Information
title: Call for Illustrators: Participation and Democracy Theme
content: Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life! SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator, artist, or illustration-led organisation to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, active citizenship, inclusion, critical thinking, community, cooperation, access to information, and having a voice. The illustrations will primarily become a series of fun and engaging stickers shared across the SALTO PI community. Open to illustrators worldwide. Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment. Approximately 10–15 original illustrations. Application deadline: 8 November 2026. Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026. Generative AI illustrations will not be accepted. Applications should include a short professional profile, selected portfolio, brief creative direction, and one example or early concept. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio.
